title: 15. Here Comes the Mail!
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Vroom, vroom! A red motorbike stops outside our house. The mail carrier slips a letter into the mailbox and rides away again. Hori's eyes grow round. Wow! Where did that letter come from? Vroom, vroom! Here comes the mail!

Inside the mailbox is a letter from Grandma. Mom, how did this letter get all the way here? Hori asks, waving it. Mom smiles. Shall we visit the place where letters gather, the post office? Kongi can come, too!

A red sign hangs outside the post office. In the yard, big delivery vans and red motorbikes stand in rows. Welcome! Have you come to learn about letters? A mail carrier in a red cap waves. Hori's heart goes thump, thump!

Hori has brought a picture letter for Grandma. To send it, you need to put a stamp here. A stamp is like a travel ticket for the letter. The mail carrier sticks a small stamp in the corner. Kongi's eyes sparkle. I thought it was candy! Look at it, don't lick it, Kongi!

Inside is a large sorting rack with many compartments. Letters go to different neighborhoods, so we sort them into these spaces. The mail carrier puts each letter into its place. Hori follows the addresses with his eyes. Our neighborhood is here!

Bigger things travel in boxes. Those are called parcels. In the yard, workers load large parcels into a delivery van. Kongi looks at a box and swallows. Are there acorn snacks inside? Everyone laughs. Vroom, vroom! Here comes the mail!

Would Hori like to be a mail carrier? The red cap is big, and the mailbag is heavy. Kongi puts the bag on too quickly and wobbles under its weight. Whoa! Hori settles his cap firmly and carefully tries sitting on the motorbike.

Now it's time to send Grandma's letter! Hori stands with the mail carrier beside a red postbox. He slips the stamped letter through the slot, and it drops inside. His tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. I sent Grandma a letter! Vroom, vroom! Here comes the mail!

With a full mailbag, the mail carrier climbs onto the motorbike. A delivery van loaded with big parcels starts its engine, too. I'll deliver these letters safely from house to house! Vroom, vroom! The motorbike sets off. Hori and Kongi wave. Have a safe trip!

On the way home, Hori holds Mom's hand and chats. Put a stamp on the letter, sort it by neighborhood, load parcels into the van, and deliver letters by motorbike from house to house! He hugs Grandma's letter. Thanks to mail carriers, we can send our feelings to each other! Vroom, vroom! Here comes the mail!
